article.title: Recovery of 3 [penalty or compensation].
article.content:
A 4[penalty imposed or compensation awarded] under this Act, if it is not paid, shall be recovered as an arrear of land revenue and the licence or the 5[electronic signature] Certificate, as the case may be, shall be suspended till the penalty is paid.
Note: the ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS still prints the pre-2009 marginal heading “Recovery of penalty.”.

Note: the ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS still prints the pre-2009 marginal heading “Recovery of penalty.”.

3 Subs. by Act 10 of 2009, s. 31, for marginal heading (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).

4 Subs. by Act 10 of 2009, s. 31, for “penalty imposed” (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).

5 Subs. by Act 10 of 2009, s. 2, for “digital signature” (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
